title: Landscape lockup / Please don’t
slide_intent: Identify invalid recombinations because a fixed lockup loses consistency when its parts are treated as independent decorations.
strategic_value: Preventing pose and placement changes can preserve Duolingo’s supplied mascot-name relationship.
demonstration: Three misuse examples prohibit changing Duo’s scale or position, letting Duo touch or sit on the wordmark, and using alternative poses.
practical_value: Check the supplied lockup rather than constructing a new combination.

content_islands.name: Misuse specimens
content_islands.spec: Arrange three crossed-out mascot and wordmark combinations in the left panel.

content_islands.name: Prohibitions
content_islands.spec: Keep the three scale, position and pose prohibitions beneath the heading in the right column.

reference_purposes.Constraint: The section prohibits changes to Duo’s scale or position, contact with the wordmark and alternative mascot poses.
reference_purposes.Application: Pictured wrong examples make these relationship errors inspectable.
